headlines.title: Climate talks stall as countries mull showdown with Saudi Arabia over fossil fuel phase-out
headlines.summary: About 130 countries pressed for language on transitioning away from fossil fuels, while climate finance, carbon capture and electrification remained contentious. Talks continued beyond their scheduled end without a final agreement.

headlines.title: International UN talks on controlling use of autonomous weapons collapse
headlines.summary: UN talks in Geneva failed to agree a mandate for a binding treaty on autonomous weapons. Consensus rules and resistance from military powers produced a weaker process; Austria was among seven countries pushing for stronger regulation.

headlines.title: Rejoining EU 'on the table' as UK makes deals on trade and young people
headlines.summary: Following new UK–EU agreements on food standards, emissions trading and youth mobility, Ed Miliband said future membership options could be considered. The government still maintains limits on closer integration before the next election.

headlines.title: Costa revives EU digital tax proposal in bid to reach agreement on budget
headlines.summary: António Costa's revised proposal for the EU's 2028–34 budget revives a digital-services levy and greater use of carbon-market revenues. Member states have yet to agree; the digital levy would require unanimity.

articles.title: ‘Little room for error’: what a debt-laden cloud computing company says about the AI boom
articles.summary: CoreWeave's GPU-backed borrowing and large debt maturities illustrate how AI infrastructure growth transfers financial risk to specialist cloud providers. The report also presents arguments for resilience, including long-term contracts and demand for older chips.
articles.new_perspective: The report shifts the AI debate from productivity forecasts to the credit structure behind GPU data centres: depreciation, collateral and advance payments could determine who bears the financial risk.

articles.title: China commits to low-carbon electrification and help for others to improve
articles.summary: China is promoting electrification and cheaper clean technologies at Cop31 while keeping coal generation for backup. Its adviser supports expanding electricity's share but argues for country-specific pathways rather than a uniform fossil-fuel roadmap.
articles.distinct_contribution: China's specific electrification strategy and trade-policy perspective, rather than a repeat of the negotiations report.

articles.title: How can investors succeed in markets today?
articles.summary: The analysis questions the assumption that government bonds always protect portfolios and stresses inflation, leverage and US equity concentration. It argues for broader diversification while acknowledging that alternative assets also have limitations.
